summary: Add PostgreSQL to an Effect API or React Router app: Compose databases, explicit migrations, a pooled client and per-file test databases.
description: Add local Postgres development and test services to the Effect stacks, with migrations applied by an explicit command and a pooled SQL client owned by the app's layer. A repository decodes every row with Schema and maps constraint errors to tagged errors. The test harness clones a migrated template so each test file gets a private database. Readiness checks the database while liveness stays independent. Product tables, queries and access rules are your work, and production hosting is separate.
seoDescription: Postgres for Effect TypeScript projects, with Docker Compose, Effect SQL migrations, a schema-decoding repository and isolated test databases.

projectExamples.title: Inventory API on Postgres
projectExamples.description: Store equipment records behind an Effect service with a Postgres repository. Add the resources, validation rules and permissions the product needs.

projectExamples.title: Booking app with saved reservations
projectExamples.description: Persist reservations from React Router actions through an Effect repository. Booking rules, availability logic and accounts are custom work.
